name: UniFi
author: James Myers
description: Your Ubiquiti network in the bar. Reads the UniFi Network Integration API on a local console or self-hosted controller and shows what is up, what is down, and who is connected. Read-only, key stored outside shell.json, certificate pinned on first use.

schema.label: Console address
schema.description: The IP or hostname of your UniFi console, e.g. 192.168.1.1. No scheme, no path.

schema.label: Port
schema.description: 443 for a UniFi OS console (UDM, UCG, UDR, Cloud Key), 8443 for a self-hosted controller, 11443 for UniFi OS Server.

schema.label: Site id
schema.description: Which site to show. Empty uses the first one, which is what almost everybody wants.

schema.label: API key file
schema.description: Path to a file containing only your API key, mode 0600. Empty means ~/.config/omarchy/unifi.key. The key is deliberately not stored here.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the console. Each poll is three or four small requests on your own LAN.

schema.label: Show client count in the bar
schema.description: Off shows only the health dot.
